short_description.id: Tuttle Bottoms Monster adalah makhluk legendaris yang konon mendiami kawasan berawa di utara Harrisburg, Illinois. Biasanya ia digambarkan seperti kera berbulu dengan moncong panjang mirip trenggiling.
short_description.en: The Tuttle Bottoms Monster is a legendary creature said to haunt a swampy area north of Harrisburg, Illinois. It is usually pictured as a hairy, ape-like animal with a long, anteater-like snout.

long_description.id: Tuttle Bottoms Monster adalah makhluk legendaris yang konon mendiami kawasan berawa di utara Harrisburg, Illinois, di daerah aliran Sungai Saline. Biasanya ia digambarkan seperti kera dan berbulu, dengan moncong panjang mirip trenggiling. Legendanya dikenal oleh beberapa generasi warga Saline County.
long_description.en: Local legend places this creature in a swampy stretch of the Saline River watershed north of Harrisburg, Illinois, and usually pictures it as ape-like and hairy, with a long, anteater-like snout. Generations of Saline County residents know the legend.

long_description.id: Menurut mantan kepala polisi Harrisburg Gary Crabtree, kantornya menerima sekitar 50 laporan selama 28 tahun tentang hewan tak dikenal di kawasan itu, sebagian menyebut dua kaki dan sebagian empat kaki. The Harrisburg Daily Register memuat apa yang tampaknya laporan pertama pada 6 Agustus 1963, dan laporan paling awal berasal dari tahun 1960-an. Beberapa laporan menyebut ukurannya delapan kaki, sedangkan remaja setempat dikatakan pernah berburu monster itu dengan senapan pada malam hari.
long_description.en: Former Harrisburg Police Chief Gary Crabtree said his department logged roughly 50 reports across 28 years about an unknown beast in the area, some describing two legs and some four. The Harrisburg Daily Register published what seemed to be the first report on 6 August 1963, and the earliest reports date to the 1960s. Some reports give its size as eight feet, and local teens were said to have gone hunting the monster with rifles at night.

long_description.id: Tentang jati dirinya ada beberapa pendapat. Seorang warga mengatakan makhluk itu bukan monster dari mitos, melainkan hewan sungguhan yang dilepaskan pemerintah federal dan sudah lama mati, sedangkan versi lain menyebut ia dilepas oleh pemilik kebun binatang pedesaan.
long_description.en: There are several views of what it was. One resident said it was never a mythical monster but a real animal that the federal government let loose and that died long ago, while another version says a rural zoo owner set it free.

claims.quote: The Tuttle Bottoms Monster is a legendary creature said to inhabit a swampy area, north of Harrisburg, Illinois, on the Saline River watershed, usually described as ape-like and hairy with a long snout similar to an anteater.

statement.id: Monster Tuttle Bottoms adalah makhluk legenda di daerah rawa utara Harrisburg Illinois dengan wujud mirip kera berbulu dan bermoncong panjang.
statement.en: The Tuttle Bottoms Monster is a legendary creature said to inhabit a swampy area north of Harrisburg, Illinois, described as ape-like and hairy with a long snout.

claims.quote: Former Harrisburg Police Chief Gary Crabtree told the Harrisburg Daily Register that his department received approximately 50 reports over 28 years of an unidentified beast in the area northwest of Harrisburg, some reporting a creature with two legs and some with four.

statement.id: Mantan kepala polisi Harrisburg menyatakan kepolisian menerima sekitar 50 laporan selama 28 tahun tentang makhluk tak dikenal berkaki dua atau empat.
statement.en: The former police chief told the local newspaper that his department received roughly 50 reports over 28 years of an unidentified beast with two or four legs.

claims.quote: Most described it as having a long, almost anteater-like snout.

statement.id: Sebagian besar laporan menggambarkannya memiliki moncong panjang yang mirip pemakan semut.
statement.en: Most described it as having a long, almost anteater-like snout.

claims.quote: On August 6, 1963, The Harrisburg Daily Register reported what seemed to be the first report of the creature.

statement.id: Pada 6 Agustus 1963, The Harrisburg Daily Register memuat apa yang tampaknya laporan pertama tentang makhluk itu.
statement.en: On August 6, 1963, The Harrisburg Daily Register published what seemed to be the first report of the creature.

claims.quote: He said it was eight feet long, four feet high and had a nose like an anteater.

statement.id: Menurut laporan koran 1963 itu, seorang pemuda menyebut makhluk tersebut panjangnya delapan kaki, tingginya empat kaki, dan berhidung seperti trenggiling.
statement.en: In the 1963 newspaper account a youth said the creature was eight feet long, four feet high and had a nose like an anteater.

claims.quote: The earliest reports of the creature date to the 1960s by teenagers who used the area as a local "make-out" spot and by hunters who would make frantic calls to the police after seeing the creature.

statement.id: Laporan paling awal berasal dari tahun 1960-an, dari remaja yang memakai kawasan itu sebagai tempat berpacaran dan dari pemburu yang menelepon polisi dengan panik setelah melihat makhluk itu.
statement.en: The earliest reports date to the 1960s, from teenagers who used the area as a local "make-out" spot and from hunters who made frantic calls to the police after seeing the creature.

claims.quote: A local resident named Virgil Smith told the Register he believes the creature is not a monster out of myth but was an actual animal "released by the federal government" that has long since died.

statement.id: Seorang warga setempat mengatakan kepada koran Register bahwa ia yakin makhluk itu bukan monster dari mitos, melainkan hewan sungguhan yang "dilepaskan oleh pemerintah federal" dan sudah lama mati.
statement.en: A local resident told the Register he believes the creature is not a monster out of myth but an actual animal "released by the federal government" that has long since died.

claims.quote: Smith said the creature was a hairy primate, stood on two legs, and was not scared of humans, adding that one couple reported the animal walked right up to them.

statement.id: Warga itu menyebut makhluk tersebut primata berbulu yang berdiri dengan dua kaki dan tidak takut pada manusia, dan menambahkan bahwa sepasang orang melaporkan hewan itu berjalan tepat mendekati mereka.
statement.en: The resident said the creature was a hairy primate that stood on two legs and was not scared of humans, adding that one couple reported the animal walked right up to them.

claims.quote: The reports have said that it is eight feet long or tall, depending upon whether it is upright on two feet, or down on all fours.

statement.id: Menurut laporan, ukurannya delapan kaki panjang atau tinggi, bergantung pada apakah ia berdiri tegak dengan dua kaki atau berjalan dengan keempat kaki.
statement.en: According to the reports it is eight feet long or tall, depending on whether it is upright on two feet or down on all fours.

claims.quote: Many local teens would wander out into the boggy areas with rifles to hunt the monster, who was known to be active at night.

statement.id: Banyak remaja setempat berkeliaran di area berawa dengan senapan untuk memburu monster itu, yang dikenal aktif pada malam hari.
statement.en: Many local teens would wander into the boggy areas with rifles to hunt the monster, which was known to be active at night.

claims.quote: The Tuttle Bottoms Monster legend is familiar to generations of Saline County residents.

statement.id: Legenda Tuttle Bottoms Monster dikenal oleh beberapa generasi warga Saline County.
statement.en: The Tuttle Bottoms Monster legend is familiar to generations of Saline County residents.

claims.quote: Also, the creature is believed to have been released into the area by either the federal government, or was set loose by a rural zoo owner

statement.id: Makhluk itu juga diyakini dilepas ke kawasan tersebut oleh pemerintah federal, atau dilepaskan oleh pemilik kebun binatang pedesaan.
statement.en: The creature is also believed to have been released into the area either by the federal government or by a rural zoo owner.

summary.id: Seorang warga: hewan nyata yang dilepaskan pemerintah federal dan sudah mati.
summary.en: A resident: a real animal released by the federal government that has since died.

summary.id: Sumber lain: dilepas oleh pemilik kebun binatang pedesaan atau oleh pemerintah federal.
summary.en: Another source: set loose by a rural zoo owner or by the federal government.
